tests.name: FeatureListDataGrid should render the hide completed features toggle
FeatureListDataGrid should have toggle checked by default
FeatureListDataGrid should hide completed features by default
FeatureListDataGrid should show completed features when toggle is unchecked
FeatureListDataGrid should save toggle preference to localStorage when changed
FeatureListDataGrid should load toggle preference from localStorage on mount
FeatureListDataGrid should show a Done feature with remaining work when hideCompleted is true
FeatureListDataGrid should hide a Done feature with no remaining work when hideCompleted is true
FeatureListDataGrid should show warning icon for Done feature with remaining work
FeatureListDataGrid should show warning icon for feature using default feature size
FeatureListDataGrid should not show warning icon for Done feature with no remaining work
FeatureListDataGrid should not show warning icon for non-Done feature with remaining work
FeatureListDataGrid should show active work indicator when getActiveWorkTeams returns teams
FeatureListDataGrid should show no-active-work indicator when getActiveWorkTeams returns empty
FeatureListDataGrid should not show active work indicator when getActiveWorkTeams prop is not provided
FeatureListDataGrid should not show the position column when the surface does not ask for it
FeatureListDataGrid should show the position column when the surface asks for it
FeatureListDataGrid should head the position column with SourceOrder's label
FeatureListDataGrid should head the position column with ManualOrder's label
createDependsOnColumn shows how many Features this one is waiting on
createDependsOnColumn leaves the cell empty when the Feature waits on nothing
createDependsOnColumn reads a counted none as nothing too, never as a literal zero
createDependsOnColumn takes the vocabulary it is given rather than naming the concept itself
createDependsOnColumn never borrows the word an instance may already have renamed for board-blocked work
createDependsOnColumn stays sortable, so a list can be read waiting-most first
createDependsOnColumn sorts on the number itself, not on what the cell happens to print
the same count is read on both Feature lists, because there is only one of them comes from the shared grid, so no surface can hand in its own version
the column speaks the instance's own vocabulary names the thing being waited on with the word this instance chose
the column speaks the instance's own vocabulary never borrows the word this instance keeps for held-up work
